title: Perfume and Incense Making
note: A home-based aromatics studio in Nairobi or Lagos can start lean with local resins, oils, and simple tools, then grow into a profitable perfume and incense brand.

startup.item: Resins and gums assortment (frankincense, myrrh, benzoin)
Glass beakers, pipettes, and mixing tools
Perfume bottles, roller bottles, and atomizers (100 units)
Incense molds, rolling boards, and drying racks

monthlyFixed.item: Workspace rent or home studio allocation
